human_notes._confidence: JAR-ONLY. NO GUIDE TRANSCRIPT WAS OBTAINED FOR THIS MOD. The one video that finished under the mythicbotany query (CfZd7UHll7E, 'Surviving With Botania :: E03 - Portal to Alfheim') turned out to be pure Botania and was refiled under botania, where it is genuinely valuable. Everything below comes from MythicBotany-1.20.1-4.0.4's own advancement DAG and lang file, which are real jar data but carry no human emphasis. TREAT THIS FILE AS A STUB -- it wants a pass over pkFjElu71Kc (Sedesin, 'Mythic Botany Tutorial - Everything About The Mod') or brU9wihmAh8 (AA Gaming, 'Complete Mythic Botany Guide'), both of which are native English and were queued but not reached.

order.claim: MythicBotany starts where Botania's Alfheim chapter ends -- the mod's own advancement root uses the Wand of the Elven Forest as its icon, so a player needs the Botania portal working before any of this is reachable.

The Mana-Infuser and the rune holders are the mod's first machinery, and the nine realm runes are its collectibles -- Alfheim, Asgard, Helheim, Jotunheim, Midgard, Muspelheim, Nidavellir, Niflheim and Vanaheim.
order.note: (jar advancement mythicbotany:all_runes, icon mythicbotany:joetunheim_rune; the runes and the Central Rune Holder are the mod's structural items)

order.claim: Two chains run in parallel after the start. One goes Alfsteel: the Alfsteel Ingot, then its tools, armour and the Alfsteel Pylon. The other goes through Mimir: the Gjallarhorn, then Alfheim itself, then the Ring of Andwari, with Mjoellnir on its own branch.
order.note: (jar advancement DAG: root -> alfsteel -> mending_repair(alfsteel_pylon); root -> mimir(gjallar_horn_full) -> alfheim(dream_cherry) -> andwari(andwari_ring); mimir -> mjoellnir -> kill_pixie)

gates.claim: Filling the Gjallarhorn from the Well of Mimir is the gate on the Alfheim branch -- the empty horn and the full one are separate items, and the full one is what the advancement chain keys off.
gates.note: (jar advancement mythicbotany:mimir, icon mythicbotany:gjallar_horn_full 'Water from the Well of Mimir'; its children are alfheim and mjoellnir)

gates.claim: The Rune Tablet of Fimbultyr and the Branch of Yggdrasil are structural items for the mod's ritual sites rather than gear -- expect them to gate the realm-rune work.
gates.note: (jar item set; not corroborated by any transcript)

bosses.claim: There is a killable Alfheim Pixie tied to Mjoellnir in the advancement chain, which suggests a combat step behind the hammer rather than a pure craft.
bosses.note: (jar advancement DAG: mjoellnir -> kill_pixie, icon mythicbotany:alf_pixie_spawn_egg)

signature.claim: Mjoellnir is the mod's headline item and the thing players install it for.
signature.note: (jar advancement DAG and item set; the corpus's MythicBotany videos are titled around 'Alfheim and Mjollnir')

signature.claim: Alfsteel is the tier above Terrasteel -- a full armour set plus the Alf Shatterer, Alf Blade and Alf Truncator, which parallel Botania's Terra Shatterer line.
The mod extends Botania's flower roster with Norse-themed generating and functional flowers, and adds greatest-tier bands above Botania's greater ones.
Mead of Kvasir and Blood of Kvasir are distinctive consumables worth their own quests, alongside the Ring of Muspelheim and Ring of Niflheim.
